title: 听力挑战 · 学术会议社交

rounds.speaker: 学者 A
rounds.line: It is a pleasure to meet you; I have read your recent paper on sustainable urban planning with great interest.
rounds.lineCn: 很高兴认识你;我怀着浓厚的兴趣拜读了您关于可持续城市规划的新论文。

grammar.name: 会议社交寒暄搭配
grammar.note: It is a pleasure to meet you 是见面问候固定搭配;read... with great interest 是礼貌评价他人研究的表达。

options.text: The speaker has read the paper about sustainable urban planning.
options.feedback: 学者 A 读过对方关于可持续城市规划的论文。

options.text: The speaker has never heard of the paper before.
options.feedback: 他不仅听说过,还认真读过。

options.text: The speaker co-wrote the paper with the other scholar.
options.feedback: 他只是读者,并未参与写作。

rounds.speaker: 学者 B
rounds.line: Would you be interested in collaborating on a joint research project concerning climate adaptation strategies?
rounds.lineCn: 您有兴趣就气候适应策略开展联合研究项目合作吗?

grammar.name: 合作邀请句式
grammar.note: Would you be interested in doing... 是礼貌提出合作的标准搭配;concerning 表关于,后接研究主题。

options.text: The speaker proposes a joint project on climate adaptation.
options.feedback: 对方提议合作研究气候适应策略。

options.text: The speaker proposes ending an ongoing project.
options.feedback: 提议的是开启新合作,并非终止项目。

options.text: The speaker proposes ignoring climate-related topics.
options.feedback: 合作主题恰恰与气候策略相关。

rounds.speaker: 学者 A
rounds.line: I found your presentation quite thought-provoking, and I would appreciate the chance to discuss it further.
rounds.lineCn: 我觉得您的报告非常发人深省,希望有机会进一步讨论。

grammar.name: 评价报告的礼貌表达
grammar.note: thought-provoking 是评价报告的高频搭配;would appreciate the chance to do 是婉转表达愿望的礼貌句式。

options.text: The speaker wants to discuss the presentation in more depth.
options.feedback: 他觉得报告发人深省,想深入讨论。

options.text: The speaker found the presentation boring and pointless.
options.feedback: 他评价报告发人深省,是正面评价。

options.text: The speaker wants to leave the session immediately.
options.feedback: 他恰恰想继续深入交流。

rounds.speaker: 学者 B
rounds.line: Perhaps we could exchange contact details and continue this conversation over coffee later this afternoon.
rounds.lineCn: 或许我们可以交换联系方式,今天下午晚些时候边喝咖啡边继续聊。

grammar.name: 建议见面搭配
grammar.note: Perhaps we could... 是委婉建议句式;exchange contact details 与 continue the conversation 是社交场景核心搭配。

options.text: They may exchange contacts and keep talking over coffee later.
options.feedback: 提议交换联系方式并约下午喝咖啡续聊。

options.text: They refuse to share any contact information.
options.feedback: 对方正是提议交换联系方式。

options.text: They will never meet again after the session.
options.feedback: 对方提议当天下午再见面。

rounds.speaker: 学者 A
rounds.line: It was wonderful talking with you, and I look forward to seeing your results at the next conference.
rounds.lineCn: 与您交谈非常愉快,期待在下一次会议上看到您的研究成果。

grammar.name: 告别表达搭配
grammar.note: It was wonderful talking with you 是告别寒暄;look forward to doing 接动名词,表达对未来见面的期待。

options.text: The speaker enjoyed the talk and expects results at the next conference.
options.feedback: 交谈愉快,并期待下次会议见成果。

options.text: The speaker hopes to skip the next conference.
options.feedback: 他恰恰期待下次会议相见。

options.text: The speaker found the conversation unpleasant.
